prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: heavy 280gsm 100% cotton jersey knitted from thick compact 26/1 combed yarn — dense, firm and fully matte, with a tight, slightly grainy surface and no sheen. The structured body holds its shape: side seams hang straight and the fabric forms only a few broad folds; it follows the muscular shoulders and chest without clinging. Firm 2x1 ribbed collar keeps a clean round shape close to the neck; reinforced seams; set-in shoulder seam exactly on the shoulder point; sleeves stand as clean tubes ending in a visible double-stitched hem. Movement: weighty and stable — where fingers pinch the hem or sleeve, the fabric bends in a thick soft fold rather than thin wrinkles.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 72 cm ending at the hip, flat chest width 54 cm giving a regular fit that follows the muscular chest with slight ease, shoulder width 46 cm with the seam on the shoulder point, sleeve length 18 cm ending mid-bicep and hugging the arm lightly.
